scope: Native i386 C interfaces for twelve MPX word operations, shared BND branch/bank effects and the RTM immediate-abort pair.

immutable_metadata_review.review: Only x86 count 1830 to 1842 for twelve fixed MPX32 signatures; declaration/type/base IDs/immutable strings/exact matching rules unchanged.

host_i386_admission.description: Five SDE modes tested with two wrappers around the same independent raw-reference assembly; excluded from NeverC qualification totals.
host_i386_admission.launcher_resolution: The sde64 launcher failed to start the i386 Pin runtime. The same kit sde launcher passed all five modes without changing system policy or the kit.

qualification_limits: MPX encoding and ABI witnesses intercept native MPX instructions; they do not execute bounds algorithms, BNDINIT or #BR delivery.
Existing QEMU MPX processor-model limitations and physical MPX qualification are unchanged.
RTM comparisons execute actual candidate and raw-reference pairs under Intel SDE; they do not establish physical RTM behavior.
The immediate-abort pair still requires an RTM-capable environment outside RTM/HLE. General transactional bodies and external checkpoints retain separate ownership.
NeverC i386 source objects use the Linux ELF external-backend driver. LLVM IR COFF/Mach-O baselines do not qualify NeverC Windows/Darwin i386 source ABIs.
The x64 NeverD continuation provider does not acquire additional guest modes from this compiler change.
Generic lifted VMFUNC leaf/state proof, full mode/task transitions, software SMM/SGX and unbound asynchronous producers remain outside this batch.

neverc_publication.verification: Atomic push followed by git ls-remote returning the exact commit for both refs.

artifact_recovery.retained: Sources, independent instruction bytes, logs, receipts, result manifests and active build trees.
